title: The First Lanterns
description: The first hidden paths were marked by lights that cast no shadows.

title: The Accord of Nine
description: Nine rival keepers agreed to protect places that should not be found by accident.

title: The Silent Hour
description: For one hour, every clock stopped and an entire street vanished from the oldest city.

title: The Archive Opens
description: A new keeper begins gathering records once considered too strange to preserve.
